sources.title: OpenThinker-7B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview OpenThinker-7B is a reasoning-focused language model built by open-thoughts through fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on the OpenThoughts-114k dataset, which was created by distilling DeepSeek-R1. The model contains 7 billion parameters and runs on the Transformers library (version 4.46.1). Training consumed 32 H100 GPUs across four 8-node machines for 20 hours with a total batch size ...
